steps: Deployed the program to devnet (upgrade authority is the lab wallet)
init_policy for agent Cr1k16TP…, daily_limit_usdc=1_000_000, window_seconds=3600 (policy ACn7AUPT…)
check_spend amount_usdc=100 signed by the agent; spent_window read back as 100
close_policy; the policy account was gone on a subsequent fetch
evidence.functional_evidence: init_policy, check_spend (spent_window=100), pause_agent and close_policy all landed; InvalidWindow, LimitExceeded and PolicyPaused were rejected as expected; the policy account was closed.
evidence.ui_check: The hosted page is the generic IDL console (connect Phantom or Solflare on devnet, then submit init_policy / check_spend / pause_agent / close_policy). It was not driven in headless Chromium in this run; the same instructions were sent with the lab wallet through the IDL client in tests/devnet/oculus.mjs.

limitations: check_spend is a policy check only: it does not transfer tokens. The 3600-second window reset was not waited out in this run. The hosted IDL was derived from source and confirmed by these transactions rather than produced by anchor idl-build.
